nphi.title: India–Netherlands Strategic Partnership roadmap 2026–2030 (health chapter)
nphi.actor: Netherlands Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport (VWS)
nphi.with: Government of India; RIVM–ICMR letter of intent
nphi.summary: Government roadmap with health cooperation on cross-border infectious diseases, AMR, vector-borne diseases, One Health, surveillance, digital health and climate and health, plus pharmaceuticals and medical devices for resilient supply…

nphi.title: RIVM – ICMR letter of intent
nphi.with: Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR)
nphi.summary: Five-year letter of intent (following an MoU of June 2025) on climate change and health, infectious diseases including AMR, vector-borne diseases, One Health and surveillance, with joint projects and capacity building.

nphi.title: GHPP India – sustainable pharmaceutical production and supply chains
nphi.actor: Netherlands Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport (VWS)
nphi.with: Indian partners (not named on the source page)
nphi.summary: Cooperation on sustainable pharmaceutical production, availability of medical products through supply chains, and a more robust health system.

nphi.title: AMR activities under the Netherlands–India MoU
nphi.with: National Centre for Disease Control (NCDC) India; hospitals in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana; Erasmus MC; Radboud University
nphi.summary: RIVM coordinates One Health AMR work in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana, covering stewardship, infection prevention and a surveillance pilot.

nphi.title: ICMR/DST – AMED Memorandum of Cooperation
nphi.with: Japan Agency for Medical Research and Development (AMED); India Department of Science & Technology
nphi.summary: Memorandum of Cooperation signed in Tokyo between India's DST and ICMR and Japan's medical research funding agency AMED on scientific and technological cooperation in medical research.

nphi.title: ICMR – Health Data Hub (France) Letter of Intent
nphi.with: Plateforme des Données de Santé (Health Data Hub)
nphi.summary: ICMR and France's Health Data Hub signed a letter of intent on cooperation in health data use for research.

nphi.title: BRICS NPHI online meeting hosted by NCDC India (2026)
nphi.actor: National Centre for Disease Control (NCDC), India
nphi.with: China CDC; NPHIs of BRICS members and partner countries (nearly 30 representatives)
nphi.summary: Under India's 2026 BRICS chairship, NCDC hosted an online meeting of national public health institutes from BRICS members and partner countries, which discussed surveillance and early warning and the operational framework of a BRICS NPHI…

nphi.title: ICMR – NIHR Letter of Intent on health research
nphi.with: National Institute for Health and Care Research (NIHR)
nphi.summary: Letter of Intent between ICMR and the UK's National Institute for Health and Care Research to cooperate in health research.

nphi.title: ICMR – SNSF Letter of Intent (with DBT)
nphi.with: Swiss National Science Foundation (SNSF)
nphi.summary: Letter of intent between ICMR, DBT and the Swiss National Science Foundation to promote joint health research.

nphi.title: ICMR/DHR regional dialogue on strengthening health research systems
nphi.with: National health research bodies of Bhutan, Nepal, Sri Lanka and Timor-Leste
nphi.summary: ICMR offered ethics forms and free training to partners and agreed regular exchanges and joint capacity building on AMR, NCDs, One Health and field epidemiology.

nphi.title: ICMR – Gates Foundation Letter of Agreement
nphi.with: Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation
nphi.summary: ICMR and the Gates Foundation formalised cooperation on health research through a letter of agreement.

nphi.title: ISP Chile–CDSCO India MoU on medical products regulation
nphi.actor: Instituto de Salud Pública de Chile (ISP)
nphi.with: Central Drugs Standard Control Organization (CDSCO)
nphi.summary: Memorandum signed in New Delhi in October 2024 on cooperation in the regulation of medical products, following the ICDRA conference and a pharmacovigilance partners meeting.

nphi.title: BRICS Vaccine Research and Development Centre (coordinated by ICMR-NIV)
nphi.with: BRICS member states' health and research agencies
nphi.summary: The BRICS Vaccine Research and Development Centre was launched virtually in 2024 during India's BRICS presidency, with ICMR-NIV Pune as the coordinating agency. It aims to strengthen vaccine R&D and health systems across BRICS member…

nphi.title: SATREPS: Vibrio cholerae genetic diversity and cholera therapeutics (India)
nphi.actor: Osaka University (Research Institute for Microbial Diseases)
nphi.with: ICMR-National Institute of Cholera and Enteric Diseases (NICED)
nphi.summary: Osaka University SATREPS project with ICMR-NICED using cloud-based genomic analysis of Vibrio cholerae diversity and developing cholera therapeutics.

nphi.title: ICMR – Institute for Basic Science (Korea) MoU
nphi.with: Institute for Basic Science (IBS), Ministry of Science and ICT
nphi.summary: MoU between ICMR and Korea's Institute for Basic Science on cooperation in basic and health research.

nphi.title: ICMR – CEPI MoU on epidemic preparedness vaccines
nphi.with: Coalition for Epidemic Preparedness Innovations (CEPI)
nphi.summary: ICMR signed a letter of intent with CEPI in Feb 2023, followed by an MoU in July 2025, on vaccine research for epidemic preparedness.

nphi.title: ICMR – Inserm memorandum of understanding
nphi.with: Institut national de la santé et de la recherche médicale (Inserm)
nphi.summary: MoU (with later addenda) between ICMR and France's national biomedical research institute Inserm for joint biomedical and health research.

nphi.title: ICMR – NIH MoU on International Center of Excellence in Research, Chennai
nphi.with: US National Institutes of Health (NIH/NIAID)
nphi.summary: MoU between ICMR and the US NIH to cooperate on an International Center of Excellence in Research (ICER) hosted in Chennai, India.

nphi.title: ICMR/DHR – University of Oxford MoU
nphi.with: University of Oxford
nphi.summary: MoU between ICMR, the Department of Health Research and the University of Oxford on collaborative health research.

nphi.title: ICMR – GARDP MoU on antibiotic development
nphi.with: Global Antibiotic Research and Development Partnership (GARDP)
nphi.summary: ICMR and GARDP agreed to cooperate on research and development of antibiotics addressing drug resistance.

nphi.title: ICMR/DHR – NIAID – BMGF tripartite Declaration of Intent
nphi.with: NIAID (NIH); Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation
nphi.summary: Tripartite declaration of intent for collaboration on infectious disease research.

nphi.title: ICMR/DHR – IVI tripartite MoU
nphi.with: International Vaccine Institute (IVI)
nphi.summary: Tripartite MoU (2017) plus Expression of Interest (2020) on vaccine research and development.

nphi.title: IANPHI Asia Regional Network
nphi.with: Public Health Institute of Mongolia (vice chair); IEDCR Bangladesh; School of Public Health and Community Medicine Nepal; National Institute of Public Health Japan; National Centre for Disease Control India; National Health Laboratory Myanmar
nphi.summary: Regional network of Asian NPHIs launched in 2016 with China CDC as chair and eight founding members, modelled on the IANPHI Africa network to foster cooperation among Asian institutes; it now counts 28 NPHIs.

nphi.title: ICMR – DNDi MoU on neglected disease drugs
nphi.with: Drugs for Neglected Diseases initiative (DNDi)
nphi.summary: Long-running MoU (2015, renewed 2020 and again in October 2025) on drug R&D for neglected diseases.

nphi.title: ICMR – IAVI MoU and tripartite MoU (with DBT)
nphi.with: International AIDS Vaccine Initiative (IAVI)
nphi.summary: ICMR and IAVI signed an MoU in 2014 and a tripartite MoU with DBT in 2022 on HIV and other vaccine research.

nphi.title: Indo-US Joint Statement on Diabetes Research
nphi.with: NIDDK (NIH)
nphi.summary: Joint statement (2012, renewed 2017) with an implementing agreement signed in June 2023 on diabetes research.

nphi.title: ICMR membership of the Global Alliance for Chronic Diseases
nphi.with: Global Alliance for Chronic Diseases (GACD) secretariat and member funders
nphi.summary: ICMR signed an MoU with the Global Alliance for Chronic Diseases in April 2011, joining an alliance of national health research funders that co-fund chronic disease research. ICMR's list says the alliance is reviewed through Strategy…

nphi.title: Okayama University India Center at ICMR-NICED (J-GRID+)
nphi.with: ICMR-National Institute of Cholera and Enteric Diseases (now ICMR-NIRBI), Kolkata
nphi.summary: Collaborative research centre at NICED Kolkata since 2007 studying cholera and other diarrhoeal pathogens, drug-resistant bacteria and environmental drivers of Vibrio cholerae.

nphi.title: SSI Strategic Sector Cooperation – India
nphi.summary: SSI cooperation with India on infectious disease preparedness, AMR surveillance and One Health laboratory systems.

nphi.title: CDC India – partnership with MoHFW, NCDC and ICMR
nphi.with: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare; National Centre for Disease Control (NCDC); Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR); National Institute of Virology; National AIDS Control Organization (NACO); AIIMS New Delhi; Central TB Division
nphi.summary: CDC has partnered with India's Ministry of Health for over 50 years, working with NCDC, ICMR, NIV and NACO on surveillance, laboratory systems, FETP workforce development, AMR, influenza and HIV/TB.

nphi.title: BRICS TB Research Network meetings
nphi.with: BRICS TB research network partners
nphi.summary: China CDC's TB centre hosted the 11th BRICS tuberculosis research meeting online in 2022, where 34 BRICS scholars and officials discussed mitigating COVID-19's impact on TB.

nphi.title: NIID Asian infectious disease research network (ICMR-NICED, NIHE, Taiwan CDC)
nphi.actor: National Institute of Infectious Diseases (NIID), now JIHS
nphi.with: ICMR-NICED (India); National Institute of Hygiene and Epidemiology (Vietnam); Taiwan CDC
nphi.summary: NIID planned an Asian research network starting with ICMR-NICED, Vietnam's NIHE and Taiwan CDC for joint outbreak investigation, pathogen data sharing, diagnostics development and AMR research, with launch targeted for as early as FY2026.

nphi.title: Inserm–ICMR bilateral call on vascular complications of diabetes
nphi.with: Inserm
nphi.summary: Joint call for collaborative research proposals under the ICMR–Inserm partnership, posted March 2024.

nphi.title: ICMR – Thailand Department of Medical Services MoU
nphi.with: Department of Medical Services, Ministry of Public Health Thailand
nphi.summary: MoU between ICMR and the Department of Medical Services of Thailand's Ministry of Public Health on medical research cooperation.

nphi.title: ICMR-NIV mpox diagnostic training for South and Southeast Asian countries
nphi.with: Health and laboratory staff of nine South and Southeast Asian countries
nphi.summary: During the 2022 mpox outbreak, ICMR-NIV Pune trained health workers from nine Asian countries in mpox testing, case definitions, sample collection and lab equipment. It also offered testing kits, reagents and probes on request.

nphi.title: ICMR/DHR – DFG memorandum of understanding
nphi.with: Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft (DFG)
nphi.summary: MoU between India's DHR/ICMR and the German Research Foundation on joint funding of health research.

nphi.title: ICMR/DHR – Colombia Letter of Intent on health research
nphi.with: Colombia Ministry of Health & Social Protection; Ministry of Science, Technology & Innovation
nphi.summary: Letter of Intent between India's DHR/ICMR and Colombia's health and science ministries to cooperate in health research.

nphi.title: ICMR – FIND MoU on diagnostics
nphi.with: FIND (Foundation for Innovative New Diagnostics)
nphi.summary: MoU listed by ICMR as signed 15 Feb 2021 with the diagnostics foundation FIND; purpose not described on the page.

nphi.title: ICMR – Nepal Health Research Council MoU
nphi.with: Nepal Health Research Council (NHRC)
nphi.summary: MoU between ICMR and the Nepal Health Research Council on health research collaboration.

nphi.title: ICMR – Myanmar Department of Medical Research MoU
nphi.with: Department of Medical Research (DMR), Ministry of Health and Sports Myanmar
nphi.summary: MoU between ICMR and Myanmar's Department of Medical Research on joint medical research.

nphi.title: ICMR – African Union MoU
nphi.with: African Union Scientific, Technical and Research Commission
nphi.summary: MoU of 2019 on South–South health research collaboration, capacity building and development of drugs, diagnostics and vaccines for regional priority diseases.

nphi.title: ICMR/AU-STRC Health Practitioners and Researchers Capacity Building Scheme
nphi.with: African Union Scientific, Technical and Research Commission (AU-STRC); ICMR-National Institute of Cancer Prevention and Research (NICPR), Noida
nphi.summary: Under the ICMR–African Union MoU, ICMR set up a capacity-building scheme for African health researchers. Its first course, on molecular biology techniques for cancer research, trained 11 researchers from nine African countries at…

nphi.title: PHE–NIMHANS collaboration on mental health and public health observatories
nphi.with: National Institute of Mental Health and Neurosciences (NIMHANS), Bengaluru
nphi.summary: MoU signed in August 2018 to develop collaborative programmes on mental health and public health system models, including support for India's first Public Health Observatory.

nphi.title: ICMR – NIID (Japan) Letter of Intent on antimicrobial resistance
nphi.with: National Institute of Infectious Diseases (NIID), Department of Bacteriology (now part of JIHS)
nphi.summary: ICMR and the Department of Bacteriology of Japan's NIID signed a Letter of Intent in Tokyo on AMR research and integrated surveillance. The two sides agreed to exchange molecular and public health AMR data.

nphi.title: ICMR – NHMRC (Australia) memorandum of understanding
nphi.with: National Health and Medical Research Council (NHMRC)
nphi.summary: ICMR and Australia's NHMRC signed an MoU in 2016, valid to 2026, covering joint research projects, scientific workshops and researcher exchanges. NHMRC reports that cooperation has mainly run through the Global Alliance for Chronic…

nphi.title: ICMR – FORTE Memorandum of Intent
nphi.with: Swedish Research Council for Health, Working Life and Welfare (FORTE)
nphi.summary: Memorandum of intent for joint health and welfare research funding.

nphi.title: Taiwan CDC – US CDC regional laboratory diagnosis trainings under the Global Cooperation and Training Framework
nphi.with: US CDC; national laboratories of South and Southeast Asian countries
nphi.summary: Series of regional laboratory trainings co-run by Taiwan CDC and US CDC under the GCTF, starting with MERS-CoV diagnostics in 2015 and followed by Zika, dengue/chikungunya and enterovirus courses for laboratory staff from Asia-Pacific…

nphi.title: ICMR – UK Medical Research Council MoU and joint calls
nphi.with: UK Medical Research Council (MRC)
nphi.summary: ICMR and the UK MRC signed an MoU in November 2015, building on joint funding calls that started in 2010 (chronic non-communicable diseases) and 2014 (substance misuse and mental health).

nphi.title: ICMR – LSHTM memorandum of understanding
nphi.with: London School of Hygiene and Tropical Medicine (LSHTM)
nphi.summary: ICMR signed an MoU with the London School of Hygiene and Tropical Medicine in July 2015 for research cooperation.

nphi.title: Indo-US MoU on cancer research, prevention, control and management
nphi.with: US Department of Health and Human Services / National Cancer Institute (NCI)
nphi.summary: ICMR and its US counterpart signed an MoU in June 2015 for cooperation on cancer research, prevention, control and management.

nphi.title: Indo-US Letter of Intent on antimicrobial resistance
nphi.with: US Department of Health and Human Services (counterpart agency not named on listing)
nphi.summary: ICMR and a US counterpart signed a Letter of Intent on antimicrobial resistance cooperation in June 2015.

nphi.title: ICMR–Research Council of Norway AMR research cooperation (INDONOR)
nphi.with: Research Council of Norway (RCN)
nphi.summary: MoU signed in October 2014 for joint calls, funding and scientist exchange on antimicrobial resistance, followed by Indo-Norwegian AMR workshops and an INDONOR call for joint projects.

nphi.title: ICMR – Russian Foundation for Basic Research MoU
nphi.with: Russian Foundation for Basic Research (RFBR)
nphi.summary: ICMR signed an MoU with the Russian Foundation for Basic Research in December 2014 for bilateral biomedical research cooperation.

nphi.title: ACILT laboratory training and the Labs for Life partnership
nphi.actor: National Health Laboratory Service (NHLS) – African Centre for Integrated Laboratory Training (ACILT)
nphi.with: CDC South Africa; PEPFAR; Becton, Dickinson and Company (BD)
nphi.summary: NHLS's African Centre for Integrated Laboratory Training, supported by CDC, provides hands-on training and mentoring to laboratory staff from partner countries, including under the PEPFAR/CDC–BD Labs for Life public-private partnership…

nphi.title: ICMR – Helmholtz Association MoU on infection research
nphi.with: Helmholtz Association (HGF), represented by the Helmholtz Centre for Infection Research (HZI), Braunschweig
nphi.summary: ICMR and the Helmholtz Association signed an agreement in 2011 for joint translational research on anti-infectives, vaccines and diagnostics, with exchanges and workshops coordinated with HZI. A 2017 addendum extended the cooperation to…

nphi.title: Indo-US Joint Statement on HIV/AIDS research
nphi.with: US National Institutes of Health / HHS (counterpart not named on listing)
nphi.summary: ICMR and its US counterpart issued a joint statement in October 2011 on bilateral cooperation in HIV/AIDS research.

nphi.title: NCDC – US CDC Global Disease Detection Centre India
nphi.actor: National Centre for Disease Control (NCDC), India
nphi.with: US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
nphi.summary: MoU signed in 2010 to establish a Global Disease Detection Centre at NCDC (operational 2011) strengthening epidemic surveillance and response, public health laboratories and workforce for pandemic influenza and emerging diseases.

nphi.title: Global Disease Detection (GDD) Regional Centers network
nphi.with: Host ministries of health / national public health institutes (not named on source page)
nphi.summary: CDC set up ten GDD Regional Centers between 2004 and 2013, working with host governments on outbreak detection and response, laboratory capacity, field epidemiology training and pandemic preparedness.

nphi.title: Indo-US Joint Statement on Environmental and Occupational Health
nphi.with: US NIH / NIEHS
nphi.summary: Joint statement from 2002, upgraded to an MoU in 2015 and renewed from 2020 for five years, on environmental and occupational health research.

nphi.title: Regional Field Epidemiology Training Programme for South-East Asia at NCDC India
nphi.actor: National Centre for Disease Control (NCDC), India
nphi.with: WHO SEARO
nphi.summary: NCDC, a WHO collaborating centre for epidemiology and training, runs a regional field epidemiology course for health staff from WHO South-East Asia Region countries.

nphi.title: ICMR – GSF special arrangement on biomedical sciences
nphi.with: GSF (now under DLR / BMBF)
nphi.summary: Indo-German special arrangement from 1976, renewed 1990 with an addendum in 2005, on biomedical research.
